page.overview:
Who is Baby Ice King?

Baby Ice King is an alternate version of the Ice King.

He greatly resembles his counterpart when he was an infant. The difference is that his crown is a mere toy.

He first appears in "The Winter King", when Fionna, Cake, and Simon Petrikov visit his universe. He is picked up by his counterpart, when Simon tries his crown but discovers it was actually a squeaky toy and says it's not going to work and places him down. Baby Ice King then proceeds to crawl off.
